media_detach_during_boot_observation.what_was_done: mount_cd toggled 0 then 1 on the controller while the unit was booted from the presented ISO, to force the images listing to re-enumerate
media_detach_during_boot_observation.why_it_was_done: a wrong diagnosis: the image had left the available listing because it was ATTACHED, not because the listing was stale
media_detach_during_boot_observation.observed_outcome: the running Ubuntu installer survived; measured afterwards over IPMI SOL, still interactive at its own menu, and chassis power reported on
media_detach_during_boot_observation.what_this_does_not_establish: that a detach during heavy reads is survivable. The system was idle at a prompt rather than reading, and casper reads the read-only lower layer from the presented medium on demand (toram is absent from the observed command line). One observation of one idle host bounds nothing.
